call_purpose: You called because leads were coming in from your form but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and a test form you filled in from another email address delivered the email.

covered.text: We explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea, and that you can do this in the email domain section of Settings.

customer_next_steps.text: You mentioned that you planned to verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings.
